last_action: TWO FEATURES CLOSED THE LAST GAPS BETWEEN THE APP AND A REAL GARDEN. (1) A PLANT'S PHOTOGRAPH IS NOW ITS PICTURE. Photos were stored and shown only in the detail-screen timeline; nowhere else in the app ever read `photo.uri`, so the image captured while adding a plant never became the plant. `src/lib/cover.ts` derives the cover (newest photo wins, since both add paths prepend) and `Pressing` takes an optional `uri`, falling back to the herbarium illustration when there is none. The photo block also now appears while EDITING, not only while adding, so a picture can be changed. Fourth instance of the same shape as daysSinceWater, tendedDays and the photo timeline: a field written and never consumed, invisible because the seed data was hand-tuned to look right. (2) PLANTS CAN BE REMOVED. There was no delete anywhere — no store action, no UI — which blocked the actual goal of moving a real garden in. `removePlant` drops the plant AND its log entries (an orphan entry renders as a row about nothing, and parseBackup already treats orphans as corrupt, so leaving them would break export round-tripping); the screen deletes the photo files, because the store does not touch the filesystem. The affordance sits last and quiet at the bottom of the edit form, behind a confirmation that names the plant, says the photographs and log go too, and says so explicitly when it is the only plant left. 21 suites / 239 tests, tsc clean, expo export --platform ios builds. iOS PREVIEW BUILD 55b80f8a CUT AND FINISHED — it carries both features and is the one to install.
next_action: (1) INSTALL BUILD 55b80f8a BEFORE 2026-09-13, WHEN IT EXPIRES — open the EAS build page ON THE PHONE, not the .ipa. Ad-hoc internal builds die on a 14-day clock; after that it must be re-cut. (2) Move the real garden in: remove the seeded example, add your own plants with photographs, then EXPORT THE DATA — on-device storage means an afternoon of typing has exactly one copy until you make a second. (3) The watering reminder has still never fired on real hardware — turn reminders on, pick the next slot ahead of the current hour, leave the phone alone. (4) Two items needing eyes rather than code: whether 'Water Marcel' still reads off-centre, and whether the Today footer should report state ('you're caught up') rather than count plants. (5) Then: Maestro against the device, TestFlight, Play internal.

blockers.description: The watering reminder — the feature the whole app exists for — has never fired on real hardware. Everything around it is tested; delivery itself is not. Build 55b80f8a makes it observable.

iOS preview build 55b80f8a expires 2026-09-13. It is the only installable copy carrying photo-covers and plant deletion; after expiry a new build must be cut before the app can be used on the phone at all.

GitHub Actions was last seen failing on account billing rather than on code — a job ran one second with no steps, annotated with failed payments or a spending limit. Not re-verified since. CI cannot be trusted green or red until Settings -> Billing & plans is checked.
